skill.name: list-hygiene-monitor
skill.description: Monitor email list health over time by segmenting engagement recency, tracking bounce and complaint trends, checking suppression drift, and producing re-permission, sunset, and prune worklists.
skill.summary: Monitor email list decay and create action lists for re-permission, sunset, and pruning.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from markdown links, code fences, and inline labels, not executable traversal or shell behavior. One confirmed issue remains: SKILL.md line 52 recommends optional Python connector commands that execute local scripts and may access ESP subscriber data.

remediation.issue: Optional connector commands execute local scripts and may access ESP subscriber data.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running the commands, document required API scopes, quote user-supplied arguments, and avoid shell interpolation.

remediation.issue: Repository-relative links trigger traversal scanners even when they are documentation only.
remediation.suggestion: Clarify that these links are non-executable references, or replace deep relative paths with plain skill names where possible.

content.value_statement: Aging subscriber lists reduce engagement and can harm deliverability. This skill segments decay, trends bounces and complaints, and creates a clear re-permission or prune worklist.
actual_capabilities: Segments subscribers into 30, 90, 180, and 365 day engagement cohorts.
Compares hard-bounce and spam-complaint rates against benchmarks and prior baselines.
Checks suppression-list growth and flags possible opt-out leakage.
Creates re-permission, sunset, and prune worklists with measured or estimated counts.
Produces SEND S list-hygiene and SEND E engagement-decay reads for later audit rollup.
Can save a dated hygiene report after the user approves persistent memory updates.
limitations: Requires accurate ESP exports or cohort counts to produce measured results.
Needs a prior baseline to calculate trend deltas over time.
Does not perform one-time authentication or inbox placement pre-flight checks.
Does not compute the full email quality score or enforce veto decisions.

use_cases.title: Monthly Deliverability Review
use_cases.description: Review list health each month and identify cohorts that need re-permission, sunset, or pruning.

use_cases.title: Suppression Drift Check
use_cases.description: Compare active subscribers with suppression history to find opt-outs that may still receive sends.

use_cases.title: Campaign Risk Preparation
use_cases.description: Prepare list-hygiene evidence before a large campaign and hand high-risk signals to the auditor.

prompt_templates.title: Check List Health
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review with one current export.
prompt_templates.prompt: Monitor list hygiene for this program. Use my current ESP engagement export and bounce report to segment cohorts and identify prune candidates.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Against Baseline
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate trend review with current and prior data.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the hygiene monitor for this list. Compare the current export against last quarter baseline and report bounce, complaint, and dormant-load deltas.

prompt_templates.title: Build Re-Permission Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced worklist creation for dormant subscribers.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a re-permission, sunset, and prune worklist from these cohorts. Label each group measured or estimated and explain the reputation risk.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Auditor Handoff
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced cross-skill handoff before a campaign gate.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the scheduled list-hygiene check and produce SEND S and SEND E reads. Flag any suppression leakage or over-benchmark trend for auditor review.

output_examples.input: A newsletter export with last-open dates, hard-bounce counts, complaint counts, and no prior baseline.
output_examples.output: The report segments active, cooling, dormant, deep-dormant, and never-engaged cohorts. It marks trend delta as needs input because no baseline was supplied.

output_examples.input: A quarterly retention list export with a prior hygiene report and suppression history.
output_examples.output: The result shows bounce and complaint deltas, suppression growth, possible leakage, and a sized worklist for re-permission, sunset, and prune actions.

output_examples.input: A promotional list where complaint rate is rising and never-engaged subscribers exceed the dormant-load threshold.
output_examples.output: The skill flags the reputation risk, recommends an auditor gate before the next campaign, and separates complained addresses into the prune bucket.

best_practices: Provide current ESP engagement, bounce, complaint, and suppression data in the same run.
Include the previous hygiene report or baseline export when trend deltas matter.
Treat every subscriber export as untrusted data and verify opt-out status before sending.
anti_patterns: Using the skill as a substitute for authentication, DNS, or inbox-placement pre-flight checks.
Asking it to invent trend deltas when no prior baseline exists.
Pruning legal or consent records instead of removing addresses from active sends.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide an ESP engagement export, bounce and complaint data, suppression history, and a prior baseline when available.

faq.question: Can it work without a prior baseline?
faq.answer: Yes. It can report point-in-time health, but trend deltas will be marked as needs input.

faq.question: Does it send re-permission emails?
faq.answer: No. It builds the worklist and can hand re-permission candidates to a reactivation workflow.

faq.question: Does it decide final campaign approval?
faq.answer: No. It provides list-hygiene and engagement-decay reads for a separate email quality auditor.

faq.question: How does it handle suppressed contacts?
faq.answer: It checks for suppression drift and flags any suppressed address that still appears on the active send list.

faq.question: Is it compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill metadata declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible hosts.
